THIS IS BY FAR THE WORST APP I HAVE EVER INSTALLED. ITS PUTS YOUR FACE  ON SOMEONE ELSE'S BODY AND DOESN'T LET YOU CHANGE THE SIZE. TOO MANY ADS. KEEPS TAKING ME TO FACEBOOK PAGE

You can't choose the hairstyles. They give you random hairstyles where you have to click forward or backwards to see other options and once you click forwards three or four times, it loads a video ad that you can't get out of until it finishes. DON'T DOWNLOAD THIS APP!! IT'S RIDICULOUS.

The ads are ridiculous.  I understand needing sponsors to keep the app free, but it's ridiculous the amount this has. Be careful clicking to quickly because you'll be redirected to the ad or playstore. Doesn't give you the option of what style to try, just horribly places your face on someone else picture with awful outfits, head pieces, and unnatural back grounds. Gives you no sense of what you'd actually look like with said hairstyle. awful design layout.  Just don't even waste your time.
